stories.title: Messi says goodbye to Argentina
stories.summary: Lionel Messi played his last game for Argentina. "The moment has arrived. I leave in peace, I gave it my all," he wrote. In the farewell match he set up Nico Paz, who inherits the No. 10 shirt, then gave a final speech as teammates and fans cried. Fabrizio Romano's post of his message got 131K likes, and Messi was among X's top trends.
